title: OneDrive web: refreshed file browsing and filtering on the SharePoint library layout
summary: The rollout dates, default state, filtering changes and PowerShell control are supported. Two minor corrections remain: give OneDrive's published product-level licensing instead of an unknown entitlement, and remove the instruction to use sharing and access settings supposedly listed in the controls table, which does not contain them.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The licensing model is unknown because no licensing specific to the refreshed layout and filters is published.
claims.quote:
OneDrive for work and school accounts is online storage space in the cloud that's provided for individual licensed users in an organization.

OneDrive is included in Microsoft 365 and Office 365 plans, in SharePoint plans, and can also be purchased as a standalone plan.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'included' and cite https://learn.microsoft.com/office365/servicedescriptions/onedrive-for-business-service-description. Replace the licensing notes and the conclusion in Cost and licensing with: 'OneDrive is provided for individual licensed users and is included in Microsoft 365 and Office 365 plans and SharePoint plans, or purchased as a standalone plan. No separate licensing requirement specific to this layout and filtering refresh is published.' Replace 'licensing is not yet published' in the cost rationale with 'no separate feature-specific licensing requirement is published'. Replace the licensing open question with 'Will Microsoft publish a licensing requirement specific to this refresh?'

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance: After rollout
claims.claim: The briefing tells readers to check sharing and access using settings in its controls table, but that table contains no sharing or access control row.
claims.quote:
confirm after rollout that your sharing and access settings behave as before, using the settings listed in the controls table.
Control rows: Setting to keep or defer the refreshed OneDrive web layout; "Return to classic SharePoint" link on modern list and library pages.
claims.fix: Delete ', using the settings listed in the controls table' from Risk assessment: Security & identity. In Governance guidance: After rollout, replace 'Confirm that sharing and access behave as before, since MC1457226 says permissions, sharing settings and policies are unchanged.' with 'Ask the pilot group to confirm that the same files remain accessible, since MC1457226 says permissions, sharing settings and policies are unchanged.' Do not add a control row.
